;; U2 warning cases: each document follows a `%%` line. Typst compiles it and its warnings -- message,
;; line, column and hints -- are what Austenite's evaluation must report.
%%
#import heading as heading
%%
#import heading
%%
#import list: item as item
%%
#import list: item as entry
%%
#let f() = { [a]; return 1 }
#f()
%%
#let f() = { [a]; return }
#f()
%%
#let f() = { [a]; if true { return 1 } }
#f()
%%
#let f() = { [a]; for i in (1, 2) { return 1 } }
#f()
%%
#let f() = { [a] + { return 2 } }
#f()
%%
#let f() = { return 1 }
#f()
